step1.title: Copy this code
step1.text: It's the same for every page and never changes. Changes you make in the dashboard show up on your website automatically.

step2.title: Add it to your website
step2.text: Paste the code once, so it's on every page: just before the closing </body> tag, or in your website builder's setting for code in the footer.

wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.how: Install the free plugin “WPCode”. Go to Code Snippets → Header & Footer, paste the code into “Footer” and save.

wix.name: Wix
wix.how: Go to Settings → Custom code → Add custom code. Paste the code, choose “All pages” and “Body – end”, then apply.

squarespace.name: Squarespace
squarespace.how: Go to Settings → Advanced → Code injection, paste the code into “Footer” and save. Needs a Business plan or higher.

webflow.name: Webflow
webflow.how: Open Site settings → Custom code, paste the code into “Footer code”, save and publish the site.

other.name: Another system or a web agency
other.how: Most systems have a field for code in the footer, often under “Tracking”, “Scripts” or “Custom code”. If you can't find it, send the code to whoever maintains your website.

delegate.text: Someone else looks after your website? Send them the code with these instructions.
delegate.button: Email it to your web team
delegate.subject: Please add our chatbot ({name}) to the website
delegate.body:
Hello,

please add the following code to every page of our website, just before the closing </body> tag (or in the footer code setting of the CMS):

{code}

It loads our chatbot. Nothing else needs to be configured.

Thank you!

step3.title: Check that it shows up
step3.text: Open your website. A round chat button appears in the bottom-right corner. Click it and ask a question.
step3.cache: Don't see it? Reload the page with Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac); some websites cache pages for a few minutes.
step3.consent: Using a cookie banner that blocks scripts? Allow this script there; the chatbot itself sets no cookies.
